name: Hanamizuki Dental
description: A dental clinic theme in jade green: a split first screen with a two-line headline and trust marks beside a booking card (7-day date strip, time-slot chips, treatment select) over stacked high-key clinic photographs, with a cut-out instrument tray breaking over its corner; then treatments with from-prices, dentists with cut-out portraits, the first visit, insurance and fees, and clinic hours. English sample content.

design.illustration: high-key (85mm f/2.8, softbox and window light, near-white ground, faint shadows, graded toward jade)

fonts.role: headings, the booking card, labels, prices, the menu and buttons (Medium and Bold, Latin subsets)
fonts.copyright: Copyright 2022 The Zen Kaku Gothic Project Authors

fonts.role: body text, leads and notes (variable roman and italic, Latin subset)

summary.en: Jade dental clinic theme: split first screen with a booking card (dates, time slots), treatments with prices, dentists, first visit, fees.
summary.zh-TW: 翡翠綠牙醫診所主題：首屏左右分割、右側預約卡（日期列與時段），接著療程價目、醫師介紹、初診流程、保險與費用、診所資訊。
summary.ja: 翡翠色の歯科医院テーマ。左右分割の首屏に予約カード（日付と時間枠）、診療メニューと料金、歯科医師、初診の流れ、保険と費用。
summary.fr: Thème jade pour cabinet dentaire : écran partagé avec carte de rendez-vous, soins et tarifs, dentistes, première visite, frais.
summary.de: Jadegrünes Theme für Zahnarztpraxen: geteilter Einstieg mit Buchungskarte, Behandlungen mit Preisen, Zahnärzte, Erstbesuch, Kosten.
